name: Richard Warden
headline: Project Director, NetSuite Customer Success EMEA - Oracle NetSuite
position: Project Director - NetSuite Customer Success EMEA
about:
A driven and highly experienced Senior Business Professional adept at working at both board level and within the detail who excels in the creation and implementation of key business and finance strategies and who as acquired extensive international exposure. A talented Finance Manager who excels within change, implementing key functions and processes and significantly transforming a company to enable reduced costs and increased profits. A Finance Professional who is happy to mix the genuine hands on activities along with the more high level and partnering tasks each day. A pragmatic leader with strategic thinking who has the knowledge and tenacity to enhance any forward thinking organisation.

KEY SKILLS & EXPERTISE 
 
• Finance and business management
• Colleague management and development
• UK GAAP and International reporting
• Expertise within private and public sector
• Change management/ business transformation
• Ability to achieve all business objectives
• Sarbanes-Oxley compliance
• Staff management of small to medium sized teams
• Hands on daily/weekly/monthly tasks
• Able to mix regular tasks & strategic activities in tandem 
• Working on group finance basis
• Extensive International experience
• Working at board level
• Business plan development
• Audit expertise
• Act with integrity and diplomacy in all situations
• Responsive to changing business demands
• Project and team management
• Adaptable across sectors
• Culturally aware

experiences.position: Project Director - NetSuite Customer Success EMEA
Customer Success Senior Project Manager, NetSuite EMEA
Consulting Technical Director, Professional Services EMEA
experiences.description:
Consultant with wide experience in finance, business and consultancy adding value to implementations. Currently working with Software, services and enterprise customers to ensure the power of NetSuite is utilised and tailored to match business growth. 

Specialist areas include but not limited to Revenue recognition, multi books and localisation, financials and core business processes. 

Additionally I am involved in Project Management for collaborative implementations and supporting the verticals management and team development. 

My customers are both in the UK and across the EMEA Practice as well as working with global organisations from North America with internationalisation.

A leading international legal practice with particular specialism in offshore law

Key Duties/ Achievements:	
•	Successfully managed all finance and business processes within this multi-currency environment, creating and implementing financial procedures to significantly enhance efficiency and company finances.
•	Overall responsibility for the full finance function, completing UK GAAP accounting, monthly and quarterly reporting, income and cost analysis and all forecasting, ensuring adherence to Russian tax standards on a hands on basis.
•	Built and managed excellent relationships on an internal and external basis including extensive liaison with the Branch Director and Lawyers as well as managing all outsourcing partners and tax authorities, improving communication channels.
•	Significantly improved debtor collection, managing and implementing changes to the invoicing process and enhancing credit control throughout the organisation.
•	Used excellent management experience to implement and oversee all staffing changes, enabling the achievement of all company objectives.
•	Played a pivotal role within a successful IT migration project, completing all aspects within timescales and budget.
•	Successfully ensured a smooth office closure.

An Irish and Russian duty free travel retail company, operating with 14 retail units within Moscow’s 2 leading airports

Key Duties/ Achievements:	
•	Direct responsibility for maintaining full accounting and reporting control, producing GAAP accounts and regular reporting packs.
•	Managed the creation of all board papers, budgets, forecasts and long term projections.
•	Completed extensive liaison with auditors, bank and credit card processor, managing any issues through to resolution.
•	Identified potential systems changes in relation to multi-currency MS Dynamics NAV.
•	Created and reported on all KPIs for Russian and Irish areas of the business, working in line with differing objectives.
•	Maintained excellent business partnerships, working extensively with General, Operations and Retail Managers.
•	Enabled informed decision making through the completion of business modeling, forecasting and analysis as well as assisting with the new outlet tender process through the production of financial projections.
•	Reported on all sales and key performance indicators by unit, product, department and time-points.
•	Provided strategic guidance in relation to sales, stock purchasing, overheads and employee costs.
•	Successfully delivered full accounting and reporting accurately and on time.

Workstream lead for Actuarial Internal Controls Risk Mitigation Project at this leading Life Assurance company. Involved in process & risk documenting, controls evaluation & gap analysis and BAU transition. Working closely with business management, process owners and Technical advisors (E&Y & KPMG).

ERP Implementation Project Manager to a interllectual property based design & manufacture high technology company headquartered on the Universities Science Park.
Achievements
•	Implementation of number of Manufacturing Works order processes from vision, through process design and business reengineering to successful Go-Live state utilising DynamicsAX one of Microsofts Mid Range ERP systems.
•	Successful introduction of improved Inventory Control processes within a partial Kanban cleanroom supporting warehouse.

Self Employed Consultant to major £3bn Financial Services Plc. Undertaking workstream lead roles I managed a number of workstreams through the full end to end SOx process. 
Achievements
•	Evaluation, Scoping, risk analysis, control identification & documentation of Business Processes across a wide range of business functions.
•	Succesful management & QA of walkthrough, test script developments & testing cycles.
•	Devising, agreeing & supporting implementation of new controls or remediation activity.
•	Establishing solid relationships with business management ensuring a smooth road to compliance even following group deregistration in the USA.
•	Ensured control environment not only achieved SOx compliance but US & UK GAAP, FSA & CCA compliance standards.
•	Part of Project management team contributing to programme review & development.
•	Successfully working with Internal Audit, External Methodology Advisors & Statutory Auditors.
•	Ensuring successful compliance sign off status for all workstreams involved in, including both General Insurance & Reinsurance books.

Principal Consultant & Interim Finance Manager within this small practice involved in a variety of assignments in a range of sectors and business types. UK based with overseas assignments in Switzerland, Holland & Poland.

Interim Finance Management - Undertook short and longer term interim Finance Controller/Business Partnering role for a number of clients in Business Support Services, Training and Education.

Whilst undertaking consulting or interim management roles I covered a number assignment areas including:-
 
•	Financial Modeling
•	Development of Budgeting/Business Plans
•	Systems Selection & ERP Implementation
•	Business Performance Improvement Projects
•	Development of, and training, in KPI’s for large and small sized businesses
•	Review of Service Delivery Models
•	Review and support of new Contractual Arrangements
•	Development of UK/European Funding bids & subsequent claims & extensions

Finance Controller of an old family controlled firm of Cotton Merchants. The business merchanted/traded cotton worldwide including Europe, Central Asia (CIS), Asia and Far East. It was US Dollar based (Trading ‘turnover’ c$150m)

Achievements
•	To develop of all aspects of the businesses systems with special responsibility of computerising the Accounts & Back Office functions to bring the records into the 1990’s.
•	Understand a unique business and ensure financial proberty within futures trading & forward contacts (both commodity and FX).
•	Prepare financial statements for the board & liase with all appropriate external organisations.

No. 2 to the Finance Director of a £100 million food and commodity business, managing department of twelve staff. The role involved substantial internal and external liaison and significant man-management, covering staff of all ages and levels of experience.

Achievements
•	Successful financial accounting and reporting, clean statutory accounts, undertaking corporation tax computations and company secretarial tasks
•	Obtaining substantial EU grant aid, making business interuption Insurance claims
•	Mergers of businesses into the company
•	Business Performance Improvement projects
•	Management of the specification, design of modifications & implementation of new ledger packages in business (involving combined commodity trading, manufacturing & sales to supermarkets).
